set.body:
Defect: A RecordRef that merely names a path reopens 'verify one thing, read another' for exactly the records P5 depends on (timebase-repair.json, alias-map.json, annotation-lineage.json). Found by the THIRD review; neither earlier pass caught it.

Do: Every load-bearing sidecar must resolve UNIQUELY to a VerifiedArtifact in the snapshot, with its own schema and version checked there.

Tests: a RecordRef resolving to nothing; two RecordRefs resolving to one artifact; sidecar bytes changed after the manifest was written; a sidecar whose schema string or version disagrees with what the reference declares.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): let a RecordRef resolve by path outside the snapshot -> the changed-bytes test must fail.

Exit: No sidecar is parsed that was not verified.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S1 'Sidecars are inside the wall'
set.title: intake P2b-i: sidecar RecordRefs must resolve inside the verified snapshot
